components.text: Explain why a perfectly loving God may permit genuinely nonresistant nonbelief while remaining open to relationship.
Explain why sincere access to adequate evidence varies strongly with geographic and cultural location.
Whether sincere nonresistant nonbelief is incompatible with a perfectly loving God.
Whether religious access that tracks geography is better expected under cultural naturalism.
Show why apparently unnecessary suffering should not substantially disconfirm an all-loving and powerful God.
Explain animal suffering without relying only on freedom, human moral development, or assured compensation.
Whether suffering has substantial comparative evidential force against theism.
Why animal suffering lacking human-centered goods is more expected under naturalism.
Explain why apparently minor or unnecessary harms may nonetheless arise in a purposive world governed by a good God.
Explain the scale and distinctive moral difficulty of animal suffering under stable natural laws.
Whether apparently unnecessary minor harms can have a sufficient purpose in an orderly world.
Whether animal suffering escapes freedom, soul-making, and compensation explanations.
Supply a warranted bridge from unexplained biological information to intelligent conscious causation rather than mere present ignorance.
Show that genetic-code optimization and constraints positively favor design over possible natural historical development.
Whether unexplained biological information positively warrants an intelligent cause.
Whether genetic-code constraints positively discriminate design from naturalistic origins.
Show that an actual resurrection is comparatively better than ordinary or composite naturalistic explanations of the reported encounters.
Show that costly sincerity and women witnesses exclude ordinary transmission, embellishment, or deception sufficiently to favor resurrection.
Whether reported encounters make ordinary naturalistic mistake explanations less likely than resurrection.
Whether costly conduct and women witnesses make deliberate fabrication improbable.
Show whether the increasingly detailed physical and group appearance reports are early independent evidence or later narrative development.
Show whether Gospel witness details reliably originate with the apostles rather than developing in later textual transmission.
Whether detailed physical and repeated appearance reports reliably establish encounters rather than developing tradition.
Whether the Gospel narratives' features make deliberate fabrication improbable.
Explain why perfect divine love permits some sincere people to lack belief and therefore lack an available divine relationship.
Explain why the amount of hiddenness and access to belief tracks geography and culture so unevenly.
Whether a perfectly loving God could permit sincere nonbelief while remaining open to relationship.
Whether the geographic pattern of belief is better explained by cultural production.
Show that ignorance about life's origin provides positive discriminating evidence for intelligence rather than a gap-based inference.
Show that apparent uniqueness or code constraints establish design rather than warranting continued uncertainty about origins.
Whether ignorance about life's origin can legitimately support an intelligent or divine cause.
Whether genetic-code difficulty supplies positive design evidence rather than an unresolved research problem.
Show that the mind-matter analogy supports supernatural justification despite the physicalist possibility that mind is simply the brain.
Whether mind-brain interaction supplies an apt analogy for justified supernatural belief without a mechanism.
